# Suraj Automation
> Indian business automation and custom software development company based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, serving SMBs across Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Delhi NCR, and pan-India.

## About Suraj Automation
Suraj Automation is founded by Suraj Singh, a Google Apps Script Developer and Full-Stack Automation Architect. We help Indian small and medium businesses eliminate manual spreadsheets, WhatsApp order chaos, and repetitive billing or reporting work using affordable custom software, Google Apps Script web applications, WhatsApp Business automation, Gemini AI integrations, and automated MIS dashboards.

## Sarthi Software Suite (Ready-to-Deploy Business Systems)
- Products Directory: https://surajdx.com/products
- BillSarthi: Automated vendor billing and GST invoice verification
- HisabSarthi: Google Sheets-based GST accounting and ledger tool
- StockSarthi: Inventory management and low-stock alert system
- SupplySarthi: B2B supply chain and distribution order management
- VendorSarthi: Procurement and vendor quotation tracker
- LoanSarthi: Loan, EMI, and recovery tracking system
- CFO Dashboard & COGS Analytics Dashboard: Automated financial & profit MIS reporting
- KarmSarthi, HireSarthi, SalarySarthi, Claimo, BudgetSarthi, BookingSarthi, RationKart, CakeSarthi, MenuSarthi, GymSarthi, PersonalFinSarthi
